== Quest information ==
=== Objectives ===
* Clear the Ruptured Heart in [[the Desolation]] of all enemies in [[hard mode]].

=== Reward ===
* 10,000 [[Experience]]
* 1,500 [[Gold]]
* 1,000 [[Lightbringer rank|Lightbringer Point]]s
* Complete the Base Objective for 150 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
